project.title: Creating posters for Instagram Posts
project.description: I like to create posters for my Instagram posts (especially in my private account) since I treat these as my brain dump page. I put all of my publicity material (pubmat) ideas to my Instagram post so that when I need to create a pubmat, I can just browse through my account.

project.title: Clay Trinkets
project.description: Clay trinkets are something I do for fun since it soothes my mind and makes me forget of the stress I have with academics and work. I also create clay trinkets as gifts for my loved ones.

project.title: Research
project.description: I like to research about the smallest things that pique my interest. For example, "was the Library of Alexandria real?" or "what's the history of witches?"
